description: Stripe is looking for Software Engineer Interns for Summer 2026. You will build and scale global payment infrastructure using Ruby, Go, Java, and React. Work alongside senior engineers to design reliable APIs handling billions in payments. Qualifications: Currently pursuing a BS/MS in Computer Science or related field, graduating between Dec 2026 and June 2027. Competitive hourly pay ($55/hr) + housing stipend, comprehensive health benefits, and mentor support. Standard formal interview process including coding assessment and system design discussion.
message: Hi Nihar, Thank you for interviewing with Stripe. We are thrilled to extend an offer for the Software Engineer Internship position for Summer 2026! Please review the attached formal offer details.
